subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should this issue be fixed narrowly by honoring explicit `heartbeat.session` for wake-triggered runs, or should it also change the default Telegram DM isolation behavior that currently follows global `session.dmScope: main`?
rationale: The heartbeat precedence bug is source-backed, but the Telegram default-isolation proposal was already closed as a product-policy shift, so automation should not silently choose that behavior.

options.title: Fix heartbeat precedence only
options.body: Make configured `heartbeat.session` outrank wake/session origins and preserve current `session.dmScope` semantics unless a separate policy decision changes them.

options.title: Adopt safer Telegram DM default
options.body: Change Telegram DMs to isolate by default and provide upgrade docs or migration guidance for users relying on shared main-session DMs.

options.title: Fold into broader heartbeat entries
options.body: Defer the fix into the native per-session heartbeat scheduling design, accepting that the current bug remains until that product work lands.

recommendation.title: Fix heartbeat precedence only
recommendation.body: Make configured `heartbeat.session` outrank wake/session origins and preserve current `session.dmScope` semantics unless a separate policy decision changes them.

likelyOwner.reason: They made the prior product-policy call on Telegram DM isolation and have adjacent heartbeat/config runtime history.
